risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantified and provides clear year-over-year results, but it includes substantial boilerplate, dense accounting terminology, and incomplete factor descriptions in the excerpt. Performance was mixed: sales increased, while gross margin and Residential segment profitability declined, and management fell short of its organic growth and operating-margin targets. Tax Reform effects were quantified, although some future impacts remained unresolved.
